name: Agent Zero
description: General agent that works inside its own Dockerized Linux computer with a desktop, browser, documents, plugins and subagents.
whatItDoes: Carries out tasks that need more than chat: using GUI software and terminals, browsing, co-editing documents and working in projects with isolated files, secrets and memory. A CLI bridge lets the same agent work in repositories on the host machine.
howItWorks: The agent runs in a Docker container and is controlled from a web UI where the LLM provider is configured. It can delegate work to subagents, and its prompts, tools, skills and plugins are editable.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Agent Zero instances run as containers

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Configured in the web UI after start
